プライバシーポリシー

Last updated: October 28, 2026

CuePrompt is designed to work in your browser without an account. This policy explains what stays on your device, what you choose to send to third parties, and how to contact us.

スクリプトs, settings and recordings

Your scripts, preferences and script library are stored in your browser. Camera recordings are created on your device and are not uploaded to a CuePrompt server. You can delete local data in your browser or export and delete your library from CuePrompt. Clearing browser data may remove locally stored scripts and settings.

Smart Follow and microphone audio

When you turn on Smart Follow, your browser sends microphone audio to its speech-recognition service to produce a transcript. Depending on your browser, this may be provided by Google, Microsoft or Apple. CuePrompt uses the recognition result to align the prompt locally; it does not receive your audio or transcript on its own server. Smart Follow needs a network connection to the browser service and may not be available in every browser or region.

Camera and microphone permissions

CuePrompt requests camera or microphone access only after you choose a feature that needs it. You can revoke those permissions in your browser or device settings. Your recording stays on your device unless you download, share or upload it yourself.

Bring-your-own AI and transcription services

If you choose to use the AI writer or configure a transcription service, the text, recording and API key required for that request are sent directly from your browser to the provider you select. CuePrompt does not supply, receive or store those API keys. Review the selected provider’s privacy terms and use a key with an appropriate spending limit.

Website delivery and communications

Like most websites, the hosting and email providers that deliver CuePrompt may process standard technical information needed to serve a request or deliver a message. If you email us, we use your message and contact details to respond and provide support.

Your choices and contact

Because CuePrompt does not provide accounts or cloud script storage, most data controls are in your browser. For privacy questions or support, contact support@cueprompt.io.

Changes

We may update this policy as CuePrompt changes. The date above shows when it was last revised.
